item.title: Favorite Sweet!
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Lost Script
  • 発売日: 2010-08-27
  • スコア: 7.13/10 (16 人評価)
  • 日本語名: ふぇいばりっと Sweet！
  • 英語名: Favorite Sweet!

あらすじ

The protagonist’s relatives are leaving overseas and plan to close up the cafe they work at. He decides to try to be the new owner himself. But the patissiere who works there is a tsuntsun girl who had dumped him at school. She tells him that if he doesn’t do a good job and sell all the sweets that she makes, then she will quit. He’s now not sure if this will go as smoothly as he thought it would.

item.title: Nagagutsu o Haita Deco
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Lost Script
  • 発売日: 2007-09-28
  • スコア: 6.529999999999999/10 (5 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 長靴をはいたデコ
  • 英語名: Nagagutsu o Haita Deco

あらすじ

When Kosuke wakes up, he finds himself being in a strange house. He meets a girl wearing boots called Hamu there. According to her, her family members suddenly went missing, and she’s been living with her pet cat since then. He starts living there to take care of her. But, he gradually becomes doubtful about the situation he is currently involved….

item.title: Sabae no Ou
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Lost Script
  • 発売日: 2006-04-28
  • スコア: 6.640000000000001/10 (20 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 蠅声の王
  • 英語名: Sabae no Ou

あらすじ

Hunter OPS’s rookie vampire hunter Ain and her master, vampire hunter Rizeru infiltrates a certain deserted village in South America.

Code 593 is activated because it is believed that this settlement has become a nest for vampires. There is also an unmanned military shelter below the village, accesible only by an elevator…

Armed with guns, swords, arcane powers and with your guidance; will they be able stop these vampires? Or will they join them in the end?
